_note: I036g: ghost ship enemies (se_ghost_ship_enemies, 16642-17048) and the Floating Skull boss (se_boss_floating_skull, 15939-16641), both bank 00. Stats from MetaStElles ($41, $44, $45, $46); switch $B6 is the boss lair record (LairRecords, type $41); $16 / $1A bits from engine_scheduler_sprites_combat_collision. Light depth.

blockNote: The enemies of the Ghost Ship scenes (world 2; file offsets 16642-17048, SNES $00:4102-$4298, bank 00): the Purple Worm ($44) with its burst variant ($46) and fragments, and the Ghost Ship Torch ($45) with its fireball. All of them are placed in the scenes (no lair record spawns them) and all remove themselves once switch $B6 is set.
=== ROSTER (meta type: attack / defence / HP / EXP; bestiary row) ===
- $44 Purple Worm: 9 / 8 / 5 / 10 (bestiary: 5 HP, 10 EXP, 'Wriggling around'), flags $0200. 'Look out for Purple Worms coming up from below.'
- $45 Ghost Ship Torch: 10 / 0 / 1 / 0, flags $0201 (bestiary: '? HP', 0 EXP, 'Fireballs'). 'The torches around here are indestructible - attacks merely will stem their efforts for a few seconds.'
- $46 worm burst: 9 / 8 / 5 / 10, flags $0300: the same stats as the Purple Worm, but it only throws the three fragments.
=== FLAGS ===

- Switch $B6 is the lair record of the Floating Skull (record $B6, location $32, one monster of type $41). COP 14 in the worm, the torch and the burst jumps to a kill (COP 86) once the boss is beaten and the lair released; the burst only freezes itself (SetEntryHere + RTL).

- $16 bit $0200 makes an actor unhittable (target mask $EEC0 of the engine); the worm clears it (STZ $16) when it comes out of the floor, the torch sets it while it is stunned. $1A bit $0100 keeps the torch alive with 1 HP.
=== OPEN ===
- The burst variant ($46) bursts when the hero is at least $30 pixels ABOVE it (COP 9B, first target); why the trap only fires then, and where the type is placed, is not known (OQ-I036-11).

partNotes.se_enemy_purple_worm_004102:
The Purple Worm: waits under the floor, comes out when the hero is near and crawls after him.

When: meta type $44; placed in the Ghost Ship scenes.
Sees: COP 14 (switch $B6) removes it after the boss; while waiting (animation $1A, unhittable by the meta flags $0200) it waits until on screen and tests the hero inside its box widened by 3; then sound $A1, COP B0 spawns three fragments (flags $0200), STZ $16 clears the flags (it can be hit now), animation $0B (it comes out); afterwards it waits until on screen and, with the hero inside the box widened by 4, COP 9C picks the axis and COP 9A / 9B (threshold $10) the side, a tile test (COP 23 / 24 / 21 / 22) stops it at a wall and it crawls by animation $0D (sideways, flip X by the side) or $0C (flip Y for up); otherwise animation $2A.
Why: walkthrough: 'Purple Worms coming up from below'; bestiary 'Wriggling around'.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: loops for ever, or COP 86 when switch $B6 is set.
Clobbers: A.
partNotes.se_enemy_ghost_ship_torch_0041A0:
The Ghost Ship Torch: lights up when the hero is near, shoots fireballs along its row; a hit only stuns it.

When: meta type $45; placed on the Ghost Ship deck.
Sees: COP 14 (switch $B6) removes it after the boss; Y - 8; ORs $0100 into its $1A (survives a lethal hit with 1 HP). It waits on animation $23 until the hero is within $40 pixels vertically (COP 9B), then plays animation 5, sets HP ($25) = $63 and clears $0200 of its $16. Then a loop of 15 passes (COP 03): when the HP is below $63 it was hit: $16 |= $0200, animation 9, animation $23, and after 300 frames (COP 1B, $012C) it lights up again; otherwise, with the hero level (within $10 pixels vertically) it plays animation 7, spawns se_enemy_torch_fireball_004231 (flags $0200), animations 8 and 6; with the hero not level it plays animation 6 and COP 04 repeats the pass, and after the 15th pass it fires anyway.
Why: walkthrough: 'The torches ... are indestructible - attacks merely will stem their efforts for a few seconds' and 'his fire-anchor attack only works if you're stupid enough to fight amongst the torches'.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: loops for ever, or COP 86.
Clobbers: A.

blockNote: The boss of the Ghost Ship, the Floating Skull, with its two hands, the fire attack and the link actor (world 2; file offsets 15939-16641, SNES $00:3E43-$4101, bank 00). Meta type $41 of MetaStElles; spawned by the boss lair record $B6 (location $32, one monster); boss_actor holds its slot and boss_fight_active is incremented.
=== ROSTER ===

- Floating Skull ($41): 17 / 8 / 69 HP / 200 EXP, flags $0000. The bestiary says 70 HP (OQ-I033-1). Walkthrough: 'magic will not affect this boss; only his hands, which are pretty much irrelevant'; no step of this file explains that.
- Hands: spawned by COP AF with flags $0201 at (x $30 / $B0, y $70); each has HP $63 and $1A bit $0100. Walkthrough: 'His hands crawl towards you; they can be beaten in ~5 hits'.
- Fire spawner (spawned with flags $0200), fire mouth and three fire anchors: the 'fiery anchors from his mouth'.
- Link actor: ties the skull to another actor (see OPEN).
=== HANDSHAKE ===

The skull and the fire spawner talk through event flag $0000: the skull sets it (COP 09 $8000) and waits (COP 05 $8000) until the spawner has breathed fire and cleared it (COP 09 $0000); the spawner waits (COP 05 $0000) for the flag to be set. The link actor reads the same flag.
=== OPEN ===

- Which actor the link copies from and onto the skull is not known: its first read is $3C of the skull, the neighbour in the actor list, and nothing in the files names it (OQ-I036-12). While flag $0000 is clear it copies that actor's x and y to the skull; while the flag is set it copies its hit-stun counter ($26) and the $0800 bit of its $16, and when that actor is dying ($0400) it freezes the skull (se_boss_skull_halt_0040FB) and removes itself.
- The 'rush forward' of the walkthrough is not a distinct step of the script: the skull moves with its animations ($1E, $1F, $20, $21); which animation is the rush is not known.

partNotes.se_boss_floating_skull_003E43:
The Floating Skull (boss).

When: meta type $41, spawned by the boss lair record $B6.
Sees: boss_fight_active + 1, boss_actor = own slot; drawn in front; waits until on screen with the hero inside its box widened by 4 (else 8 frames per pass); then animation 0, COP 85 spawns the link, COP B0 the fire spawner (flags $0200), COP AF the left and right hands (flags $0201). Loop: four turns (flip X cleared and set, animation 1), animations $20 and $1E, sets flag $0000 and waits until the spawner has cleared it, animation $1F, then faces the hero by his x (below $80: flip X clear, otherwise set) with animation $21.
Why: walkthrough: 'Rushing forward ... Releasing fiery anchors from his mouth'.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: loops for ever (the boss dies through the engine).
Clobbers: A, Y, boss_actor, boss_fight_active.

partNotes.se_boss_skull_hand_left_003F3F:
The left hand of the skull: crawls after the hero; after ten points of damage it retreats for a while.

When: spawned (COP AF, flags $0201) by the skull.
Sees: drawn in front; ORs $0100 into $1A (cannot be killed: 1 HP is kept). code_003F4A: flips cleared, x = $30, y = $70, animation $25 twenty times (it comes out), HP = $63, $16 bits $0300 cleared. While the HP is $5A or more COP 9C picks the axis and COP 9A / 9B (threshold 0) the side: it crawls by animations $27 / $29, $10 / $12, $0F / $11 or $26 / $28 with the matching flips. Below $5A it ORs $0300 into $16 (unhittable, no hit source), plays animation $25 twenty times (it goes in), waits 300 frames and starts again.
Why: walkthrough: 'His hands crawl towards you; they can be beaten in ~5 hits' and 'The hands themselves are easily dealt with just because they get in your way'.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: loops for ever.
Clobbers: A.
partNotes.se_boss_skull_hand_right_003FEC:

When: spawned (COP AF, flags $0201) by the skull.
Sees: COP 96 first (flip X set); code_003FF9: x = $B0, y = $70, animation $0E twenty times to come out, HP = $63; the crawl and the retreat below HP $5A (animation $0E again, 300 frames) are those of se_boss_skull_hand_left_003F3F with the animation pairs swapped.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: loops for ever.
Clobbers: A.
partNotes.se_boss_skull_link_00409B:
The link actor of the skull (see the block note).

When: spawned (COP 85) by the skull before its other actors.
Sees: its y field holds the skull's slot and its x field the slot read from $3C of the skull; each frame, with flag $0000 clear, it copies the x and y of that actor onto the skull; with the flag set it copies the hit-stun counter $26 and the $0800 bit of $16 and, when that actor is dying ($0400), sets the skull's resume address to se_boss_skull_halt_0040FB with a wait of 0 and removes itself.
Why: not known (OQ-I036-12).
In: X = D = slot of the new actor.
Out: RTL (one pass per frame).
Clobbers: A, Y.
partNotes.se_boss_skull_halt_0040FB:
Halt routine of the skull: clears its speeds.

When: the link actor made it the resume address of the skull.
Sees: STZ $04 and $06 (dx, dy).
In: X = slot of the skull.
Out: RTL.
Clobbers: none.
